text:
morgan: Quick ping — PR #4128 is ready but CI flagged a couple of style nits. Can someone take a quick look? I can squash after approvals.

alex: On it, give me ~30m. what's failing on CI?

ci-bot: CI Lint check failed on branch feature/reqid-rename:
- gofmt: files in pkg/api/ need formatting
- golangci-lint: exported field name mismatch (ReqID vs RequestIDHex)
- protoc: proto json_name mismatch for RequestId -> request_id

sam: Looks small — two parts: formatting + consistent naming. Try these locally first:
```bash
gofmt -s -w ./pkg/
# optional: run autofix for lints
golangci-lint run --fix
```
That should handle the gofmt and a chunk of the lints.

morgan: Thanks — ran gofmt and fixed the easy lints. Still seeing the proto json_name issue, and one remaining export-name nit. @alex @sylvie can you eyeball? :wave:

sylvie: Two quick notes: 1) keep the JSON tag as `request_id` so downstream logs don't change. 2) for internal var names prefer camelCase, but exported types should be explicit (RequestIDHex is fine). Example fix in the struct: 
```go
// keep json tag for compatibility
RequestIDHex string `json:\"request_id\"`
```
And update the proto field to set `json_name = \"request_id\";` to avoid the protoc mismatch.

alex: LGTM after you rebase on main and squash commits. Small ask: add one-line entry in CHANGELOG under "internal" explaining the rename and compatibility note.

morgan: Will rebase + squash and add the changelog line. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ci-bot: CI queued for re-run once branch is updated.
